During the financial year 2025-26, the Company initiated the process for raising funds through a rights issue of equity shares. The Company incurred certain costs
aggregating to ₹ 81.50 lakhs towards the proposed rights issue, including ₹60.31 lakhs towards stamp duty/fees in connection with the increase in authorised share
capital. As at 30 September 2026, the rights issue was under process and the requisite approval/sanction for the rights issue had received. Accordingly, qualifying costs
directly attributable to the proposed equity transaction have been deferred and disclosed under Other current assets, pending completion of the rights issue. The
